statusTaxonomy.IMPLEMENTED: Code change completed and statically checked.
statusTaxonomy.TESTED: Covered by a dedicated test that fails on regression.
statusTaxonomy.MEASURED: Empirical metric produced by a reproducible run.
statusTaxonomy.QUALIFIED: Passed every declared gate for the stated role.
statusTaxonomy.BLOCKED/NOT_RUN: Explicitly blocked or not run, with the blocking condition recorded.

R8-01.title: P0 structural defect remediation and runtime gate clamping

details.modelIdentityFreezing: Explicit requested-vs-actual policy tracking. A missing or mismatched model raises MODEL_LOAD_ERROR / NOT_RUN and never silently substitutes another model.
details.finiteWeightAssertions: Strict Number.isFinite() checks on all exported Spatial ResNet and NET_A DualHead weights.
details.spatialPredictSignature: Predictor called with the strict 2-argument signature predict(encodedState, candidateActions).

R8-02.title: Protocol and engine defect remediation (stagnation, step bounds, PRNG, rehire accounting)

details.stagnationTruncation: Artificial unchanged-unit-count truncation removed; only true terminal states or maxAtomicSteps terminate a match.
details.implicitStepBounds: maxTurns and the atomic step limit are decoupled; no maxTurns * N step heuristic remains.
details.independentPrngStreams: Candidate, opponent, and search policies each consume an independent deterministic PRNG stream.
details.rehireAccounting: Rehire opportunities/successes derive from real engine recruit_to_castle actions.

R8-03.title: Historical checkpoint audit and clean baseline benchmark

original_v7_weights.details: Original v7 weights are unrecoverable from disk and git history; formally BLOCKED.

clean_v8_closure_benchmark.details: closure_01 120-match, 6-policy benchmark under maxAtomicSteps=800, 25168 decisions. Benchmark SHA-256 9d367317e10b89656d8b021e1b71ed6cd2bf308932a4b58de12e3576b7f293ff.

R8-04.title: Bounded search regression, response chain and runtime gate hardening

details.softVsHardDeadline: BoundedSearchBudget now separates the soft maxMs budget (stop expanding, keep one real candidate) from the hard hardMaxMs ceiling (the only path allowed to return the HeuristicAI top action).
details.singleHeuristicScoringPass: One HeuristicAI scoring pass per decision is reused for the fallback top action, candidate filtering, and the fill quota, removing the duplicated scoring and state copy that dominated the old fixed overhead.
details.candidateCounters: BoundedSearchResult reports candidatesEvaluated and shallowEvaluations; the benchmark aggregates them per policy.
details.budgetEnforcement: Quotas verified with { maxMs: 200, maxNodes: 20, hardMaxMs: 900 }.
